# Part III: The Craft of Outputs {.unnumbered .part}

Part II taught each format through one guide for a tourism office. This part is for the
documents professionals are asked for, and it takes them one kind at a time, from one set of
results: the evaluation that @sec-fast-path started, in which Acme Signals, a fictional
start-up, compares three releases of a model on real public data.

Each chapter teaches its output the same way (@sec-three-skills): the **vocabulary** of what
the format can do, so that you can ask for it by name; a **specification**, a tested prompt
and the rules that belong in `AGENTS.md`; and the **verification** that shows the result is
right, from the diff, the render and the checks that run without you. You will rarely write
a theme or a template by hand; you will often need to know that one exists, what to call it,
and what a good one looks like.

**@sec-results, One Set of Results.** Why every result is computed once and read by every
document, what tests, guards and the render each catch, and a model card written as one larger
task, with a plan first and its checks after.

**@sec-slides, Slides That Carry a Decision.** What makes a technical deck work, the Reveal.js
features that serve it, a theme whose contrast a test checks, a PDF from print view, and the
same deck in PowerPoint in a house template.

**@sec-sites, A Site and One Brand.** One brand file for the site, the deck and the PDFs, Word
and PowerPoint templates made from it, a website with a home page, an About page and search,
and a script that checks every page.

**@sec-white-papers, White Papers and References.** A paper that stands on its own outside the
company: numbered sections, cross-referenced equations, tables and figures, citations in one
style in every format, references a script confirms, and a house template for the PDF.

Every chapter starts from the checkpoint the one before it ends at, so you can start at any of
them; if you came by the route from zero, take the fast path first, because this part
continues its repository.

![Where we are: Part III.](media/roadmaps/part-craft){.on-light fig-alt="Where we are: Part III: The Craft of Outputs, highlighted among the book's four parts. Its chapters in order: 10, One Set of Results, build: a model card and a report with numbered sections, ends at checkpoint 15; 11, Slides That Carry a Decision, build: a deck as Reveal.js, PDF and PowerPoint, with a tested theme, ends at checkpoint 16; 12, A Site and One Brand, build: a branded site, Word and PowerPoint templates, a page checker, ends at checkpoint 17; 13, White Papers and References, build: a white paper with checked references and a house template, ends at checkpoint 18."}
